text:
Alice M: Quick sync — we need to align on the 0.15 version bump across API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Target cutoff: Fri 2026-03-20 EOD PST. Who can own merge windows and changelog entries?

Ben G: I can own API and SDKs. Will open PRs to bump deps and tag.

Carol S: I'll handle runtime. Need to coordinate quantization flag name changes — will post PR tonight.

Dave K: Console team — we have a minor UI migration that touches the console versioning. ETA Thu morning. Can we decouple the console bump if needed?

Alice M: Yes, console can be decoupled. Rollout policy: runtime + API must land before console for compatibility. If console lags, we'll roll back console client version in SDKs.

release-bot: release-branch created: `release/0.15.x` by @Alice M

Ben G: PR checklist I'm using:
```
- bump version in package.json / setup.py
- update changelog under Unreleased -> 0.15.0
- add compatibility note for runtime 0.15
- run CI: unit + integration
```

Carol S: Noting special step for runtime: migrate KV cache key prefix. Patch will include migration script; tagging as breaking-change in changelog.

Erin V: heads-up: Dedicated infra may need config tweak for compaction window. I'll test against the release branch tomorrow.

Dave K: Will coordinate the console feature flag. If we need extra time, I'll request a patch release for console only.

Alice M: Solid. Owners: Ben(API/SDK), Carol(runtime), Dave(console). Erin(infra) testing. I'll own the changelog consolidation and final cut.

Ben G: I'll post PR links here once ready.

Carol S: FYI: runtime PR will include a short migration note. Please review asap.

Alice M: timeline recap:
- Wed: PRs opened + basic CI green
- Thu AM: reviews completed
- Thu PM: merge to release/0.15.x
- Fri EOD PST: cutoff for final version bump

Ben G: ack :thumbsup: 

Dave K: ack :thumbsup: 

Carol S: ack :+1: 

Alice M: If anyone hits blockers ping me and mention `@release` so the oncall sees it.

release-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-19T17:00:00Z — cutoff reminder

Ben G: added `0.15` label to my PRs

Carol S: linked runtime PR to changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421

Alice M: thanks — will do a final sweep Thu evening. Keep short notes here for cross-team visibility.
